title: Room-to-room compass directions in wilderness areas (Iron Downs downs, Wardmoor moor) were not always geometrically consistent — 'south' from one node sometimes led back the way I'd come rather than continuing a logical loop, making backtracking via cardinal directions unreliable; 'get your bearings' was needed constantly to reorient.
